shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && git ls-files && cat package.json 2>/dev/null

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; head -40 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i "toast|notif" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Toaster ToasterProvider ToasterComponent useToaster Button
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Toaster ToasterProvider ToasterComponent useToaster 2>&1 | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/Toaster/ build/esm/components/Toaster/*/ 2>/dev/null; cat build/esm/components/Toaster/index.d.ts build/esm/components/Toaster/types.d.ts build/esm/components/Toaster/Toaster.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -n "Toast" build/esm/components/index.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster && cat Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts hooks/useToaster.d.ts constants.d.ts; cat ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.js; grep -n "autoHiding\|DEFAULT_TIMEOUT\|5000" Toast/Toast.js constants.js | head; grep -n "position\|right\|bottom" ToastList/ToastList.css | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -n 1,20p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToastList/ToastList.css; rg -n "spacing-[0-9]" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md | head -8; cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts
